en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing two large, symmetrical multi‑storey barrack buildings facing an open parade ground or courtyard. The architecture is plain and functional with many identical windows and mansard-style roofs with flat roof decks and railings. In the foreground is a grassy area and paved paths; in the background the sky is mostly cloudy. At the lower edge there is German caption text indicating a military barracks for an observation unit in Meissen. A red handwritten number "27057" appears at the top right.
